text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan!
Hurry! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, McQueen,
she just dashes off in a flash...!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Running with you just makes me so happy...
...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright, alright!
I'll catch up enough to make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, really!?
Heheh, I'm so happy!
(*pitter-patter-patter—*)

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hey!
Catch up to them first before you do that~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Mmh... A dream...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (How nostalgic... It has been a long time since I last dreamed of my childhood.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be...
because I'm meeting her today...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, this is no time to be daydreaming.
I must get ready quickly.
(*Chatter, chatter... Buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a GⅠ race, there are so many people...
Just where could she be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—McQueen! Over here, over here!
Over this way~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ryan! I shall be right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always, Ryan.
To think you've managed to take the front row.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The intensity is completely different from the front compared to the back.
Look, even McQueen when it comes to baseball—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoops, my bad! Was that supposed to be a secret?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with excitement like this,
I'm certain no one will hear us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Today, we are spectators too.
Let us enjoy watching the races to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
All right, let's cheer at the top of our lungs!
“—Today, training with Mejiro McQueen is canceled.”

Since today was a GⅠ race day,
I decided to head to the racetrack to watch.

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Female)
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's off to a good start!
The battle for the lead begins here!
(WAAAAAAAH--...!!)
As I marveled at how incredible the excitement of a GⅠ race truly was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goooo――!
The race truly begins from hereーー!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone, take your positions while you still canーー!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but I am focusing on the race right now!
If you wish to talk, please wait until afterward!

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Female)
text_block_list.text:
—breaks away right now
and crosses the finish line in fiiiiiirst place!!
(WAAAAAAAH--...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That was a lovely race, wasn't it?
Everyone battling it out right until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I could feel a fierce spirit and an unyielding will
to never accept defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Like desperately not wanting to lose to a rival,
or that this is the one race you can never afford to drop—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone must have
their own strong feelings about this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I was surprised.
To think McQueen's Trainer came along too."
choice_data_list: It was purely by chance, so it surprised me too.
It was purely by chance, so it surprised me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're right about that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was the one who invited McQueen
today to go watch a GⅠ race together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We decided that we should see the stage
where we are to battle with our own eyes."
choice_data_list: Once the new year rolls around, it's the Classics, huh.
Once the new year comes, it'll be time for the Classics, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What every Umamusume dreams of
is the historic, grand stage of the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if the Tenno Sho is my ultimate goal,
I still have dreams of my own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will brace myself
so that I can deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, now that the race is over, shall we head out?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, would everyone
like to join me for some tea after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry...!
I have training coming up right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that how it was?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please don't mind me
and have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, see you later, McQueen!
Trainer-san too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I figured Ryan's passion for
the Classics must be strong, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Within the Mejiro family, my sights are on the Tenno Sho. And hers are—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Because she was expected
to achieve the Classic Triple Crown.

"The grand stage of the Classics—a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
That battle is finally about to begin."

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan!
Hurry! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...! Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...Ever since I was little,
I was always just looking at McQueen's back.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(It's come to feel like second nature now,
but thinking back, it's been like this ever since then...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (—I've never been able to catch up to you.)
